PrivacyPolicyText.title: Privacy Policy — Qwen Image Editor
PrivacyPolicyText.description: Read our Privacy Policy to understand how Qwen Image Editor protects your uploaded images, user credentials, and personal information securely.
PrivacyPolicyText.detailText:
### 1. Information We Collect

Qwen Image Editor respects your privacy. We collect minimal account data (such as email via Google Auth) and temporary image uploads strictly required to perform AI inference.

### 2. Image Usage & Privacy

Your uploaded input images and edited outputs remain strictly your property. We do not use your private images to train third-party machine learning models without explicit consent.

### 3. Data Storage & Security

All media files are safely transferred via TLS and stored in secure Cloudflare R2 object storage with granular access control.

### 4. Third-Party Services

Payment details are handled securely by Stripe under PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance. We never store credit card numbers on our servers.

### 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using Qwen Image Editor, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

### 2. Acceptable Use

You agree not to use the service to generate illegal, hateful, explicit (NSFW), defamatory, or infringing content.

### 3. Intellectual Property Rights

Subject to applicable AI model licenses, you retain rights to the images you generate and edit through the platform.

### 4. Subscription & Billing

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the end of the billing period. Refund requests are handled in accordance with our refund policy.
